title: 第159章 饲养蝙蝠奖励皆是黄阶物品第158章 我苦修大半年不如你看图半时辰
slug: 九叔饲养百倍返还僵尸成旱魃
content_zh:
山海灵虚界内。
苏辰凭空出现后，四下扫了一眼。
火羽鸡、芭蕉精，还有那几只刚刚换绑进来的新饲养物，已经有不少的倒计时归零，可以进行下一轮的投喂了。
他的目光在几处栏位上仔细扫过，最后，落在了禽类栖息地上。
目前所有主栏饲养物中，火羽鸡的品质是最低的。
为了能获得更高品质的东西，还是先用火羽鸡当一个垫子吧。
想到这里，苏辰径直走到饲养栏面前。
火羽鸡感应到苏辰那熟悉的气息，它立刻抬起脑袋，欢快地扑腾着翅膀，迈着小碎步屁颠屁颠地跑了过来。
“咯咯咯——”
火羽鸡亲昵地拿毛茸茸的脑袋去蹭苏辰的裤腿。
苏辰有些好笑地伸手将它拨到一旁，笑骂道：
“别急，少不了你这口吃的。”
他挑挑拣拣地取出了几样蕴含火属性的灵材。
又随手捏碎了少量低阶的丹药辅料作为调和。
不过片刻功夫，便在他掌心凭空凝成了一团散发着淡淡赤色光晕、香气扑鼻的上品食饵。
苏辰信手一抛，将食饵精准地投入了不远处的石槽中。
火羽鸡早就眼巴巴地等在旁边了。
食饵刚一落下，它便犹如饿虎扑食般迈开爪子冲到槽前，一头扎进去疯狂地低头啄食起来。
笃笃笃——
鸡喙敲击石槽的声音密集响起。

与此同时，期待已久的系统提示音，也在苏辰脑海中响起。
【叮！投喂成功！】
【饲养物：火羽鸡。】
【投喂资源：上品食饵。】
【检测到禽类专精加成已生效！】
【正在为您结算返还倍率……】
苏辰眼前的虚空中，金色转盘随之凭空浮现。
转盘上的指针开始快速旋转，拉出一圈圈金色的残影。
一圈……
两圈……
三圈……
速度逐渐放缓，伴随着“咔哒”一声脆响。
指针最后稳稳地停在了一个数字区间上！
【叮！恭喜宿主！本次返还倍率：九十四倍！】
九十四倍！
看到这个数字，苏辰忍不住挑了挑眉。
虽然没有一发入魂直接突破百倍大关，但在日常投喂中，这也绝对算得上是极高的暴击倍率了！
他眼神微亮，呼吸稍稍加快，继续看向后面紧接着跳出的奖励列表。
content_en:
In the realm of mountains and seas.
After Su Chen appeared out of thin air, he glanced around.
The countdowns for the fire-feathered chickens, plantain spirits, and the few new animals that have just been brought in have already reached zero, and the next round of feeding can begin.
His eyes carefully scanned several fences, and finally landed on the bird habitat.
Currently, turkey chickens are of the lowest quality among all main-stall animals.
In order to obtain higher quality items, let's use the turkey feather chicken as a mat first.
Thinking of this, Su Chen walked straight to the breeding pen.
The Fire Feather Chicken sensed Su Chen's familiar aura, and it immediately raised its head, flapped its wings happily, and ran over with small steps.
"Giggle--"
The fire-feathered chicken rubbed its furry head affectionately against Su Chen's trouser legs.
Su Chen stretched out his hand to push it aside in a funny way, and cursed with a smile:
"Don't worry, you're going to have to stutter."
He picked out several spiritual materials containing fire attributes.
He also casually crushed a small amount of low-level elixir ingredients as a blend.
In just a moment, a ball of top-quality bait with a faint red glow and fragrant aroma condensed out of thin air in his palm.
Su Chen casually threw the bait into the stone trough not far away.
The Fire Feather Chicken has been waiting eagerly nearby.
As soon as the bait fell, it rushed to the trough with its claws like a hungry tiger pouncing on food, dove in and began to peck crazily.
Tuk-tuk-tuk——
The sound of chicken beaks hitting the stone trough was loud.
At the same time, the long-awaited system prompt also sounded in Su Chen's mind.
【bite! Feeding successful! 】
[Feed: Fire-feather chicken. 】
[Feeding resources: top-grade bait. 】
[The detected poultry specialization bonus has taken effect! 】
[Settling the refund rate for you...]
In the void in front of Su Chen's eyes, a golden turntable appeared out of thin air.
The pointer on the turntable began to rotate rapidly, pulling out circles of golden afterimages.
One lap...
Two laps...
Three laps...
The speed gradually slowed down, accompanied by a crisp "click" sound.
The pointer finally stopped firmly on a digital range!
【bite! Congratulations to the host! This return rate is: ninety-four times! 】
Ninety-four times!
Seeing this number, Su Chen couldn't help but raise his eyebrows.
Although none of the soul-entering shots directly break through the hundred-fold mark, in daily feeding, this can definitely be regarded as an extremely high critical hit multiplier!
His eyes brightened slightly, his breathing quickened slightly, and he continued to look at the reward list that popped up behind him.
